quests.title: The Lost Axe
quests.start_notify: Explore the beach. Something may have been left behind.

objectives.text: Find the first clue to the missing axe.
Follow the trail into the forest and find the hidden path.
objectives.notify: The marks lead to the forest. Look for anything unusual - a path may be hidden.

objectives.text: Search the forgotten sanctum for inscription fragments.
objectives.notify: A forgotten sanctum! Search its ruins for pieces of an inscription.

objectives.text: Set the three stone pillars to the right symbols.
objectives.notify: Read the great tablet, then turn the pillars.
objectives.text_hard: Set the five stone pillars to the right symbols.
objectives.notify_hard: Read the great tablet slowly. Every line matters; the order is not the one you may expect.

objectives.text: Light the three lamps inside the sanctum.
objectives.notify: The gate is open, but the sanctum is utterly dark. Find the lamps and light them.

objectives.text: Enter the inner sanctum and examine the altar.
objectives.notify_hard: The lamps burn. The altar stands revealed.
